description: This is a bash script used for managing platform-specific upgrade and bootloader functions in an embedded Linux environment, specifically for OpenWRT on x86 architecture. The script includes functions for checking images, copying configuration, upgrading bootloaders, and performing system upgrades by manipulating disk partitions and files.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Checks if the provided image is valid by examining its magic word, extracts the boot sector, and compares partition tables to determine if a full image write is needed.

methods.name: platform_copy_config
methods.description: Copies backup configuration data to a mounted partition, typically used to restore settings during upgrade.

methods.name: platform_do_bootloader_upgrade
methods.description: Upgrades the system bootloader by mounting the boot partition and running grub-bios-setup with appropriate parameters.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs the overall system upgrade, including partition table comparison, image writing, UUID updating, and bootloader upgrades, based on detected differences.
